tweet.text:
I just ran a swarm-forge (branch six-pack) with six agents.  Specifier, coder, cleaner, architect, hardender, QA.  The specifier writes both Gherkin and user oriented QA procedures.  Coder codes.  Cleaner refactors. Architect manages modules and dependencies.  Hardener run mutation tests.  QA runs the specifiers QA procedures.  

Outcome was a usable application with a solid architecture and overloaded with unit tests, acceptance tests, and QA tests.
